name: Urban Craft
sourceUrl: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Urban+Crave (Menu photo tab - printed menu photos and in-store digital menu board)
crossCheckedAgainst: Digital menu board photo on same Google Maps listing (Grab & Go / Burgers & Sandwiches / Salad sections match the printed menu photo to the cent)
notes: Work item name "Urban Craft" with no website is an OSM mislabel; the actual business at this address (3225 N Harbor Dr, San Diego International Airport Terminal 2, formerly listed as Terminal 1) is "Urban Crave", confirmed by matching review count (677 in work item vs 668-678 seen live) and address. No independent website/ordering platform exists for this airport concession (operated by SSP); source is photos of the restaurant's own printed menu and digital menu board from its Google Maps Menu photo tab. Two printed-menu photos in the same photo set show different prices for breakfast items (e.g. Breakfast Burrito $16.99 vs $15.31, Bases Loaded Breakfast $21.49 vs $19.29) - the higher-priced photo showed those specific items with a bordered/updated-look treatment, consistent with FINDINGS guidance that the photo with consistently higher prices is the later revision; breakfast prices below are taken from that higher/more-recent photo. Non-breakfast sections (Starters, Salad, Burgers & Sandwiches, Grab & Go Combo) are taken from the clearer digital menu board photo, which matches the printed menu photo's prices on every overlapping item. Beverages (juice, soda, coffee, etc.) are listed on both boards with no prices shown and are omitted. Sections reached: Breakfast, Mary's & Mimosas, Starters, Salad, Burgers & Sandwiches, Grab & Go Combo, Beverages (unpriced). A 2% surcharge line printed on the menu (staff recruitment/retention) is the restaurant's own posted price, not a markup, and is not added to the prices below.

name: Mignon Pho + Seafood
sourceUrl: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Pho+Mignon+%2B+Seafood (Menu photo tab, printed physical menu photos)
notes: Own site (mignonpho.com) 404s / does not resolve. The restaurant's order.online (DoorDash white-label) storefront was checked and rejected as a source: its Crawfish Seafood Boil is listed at $21.00/lb against $18.00/lb on the restaurant's own printed menu (a 1.17x gap), and nearly all its prices land on whole dollars or .50, the same rounded-markup signature documented for Fleming's in FINDINGS.md - so order.online prices are not used. Dishes below are read directly from photos of the restaurant's own physical menu (laminated pages and an AYCE BBQ insert) on its Google Maps listing Menu photo tab. This covers the Small Bites, Deep Fried Bites, French Fries, Seafood Boil, and All You Can Eat BBQ sections, which is what photographed cleanly - the core Pho, Banh Mi, Rice Plate, and Vermicelli sections (present on order.online but not trusted on price) were not found in a trustworthy priced form and are omitted rather than guessed. This is a partial capture of a larger menu, not the whole thing.

notes: Prices on the restaurant's own menu page carry unusual precise cents ($26.89, $17.74, etc.) and the page itself discloses this is intentional: "MENU PRICES SUBJECT TO VARY" and a 4% surcharge notice both appear on the page, consistent with a fine-dining seafood restaurant running dynamic/live pricing tied to ingredient cost. Verified visually in a real browser (not just text extraction) that these are genuinely rendered, not a fetch artifact. Two items, Chorizo Pizza and Margherita Pizza, displayed as $228.76 and $223.94 - an obvious site display bug (10x+ every neighboring entree/pizza price, including the third pizza on the same page at a normal $32.33) - and were dropped rather than guessed at. Prices recorded reflect a snapshot taken 2026-08-27 and may already differ given the site's own disclaimer.
